What the checksum checks

The recorded SHA-256 checksum binds the assignment definition, question positions, product labels, protected source data and instruction images. Student answers and identity fields can change. An optionally assigned student ID is checked separately. A full-file hash would change whenever Excel saves an answer.

A mismatch rejects the assignment version for grading; it does not prove misconduct. A matching workbook or completed image task does not prove that the student worked without assistance. The original VBA project and Generate Data control are retained. Excel may rewrite the VBA container when it adds the locked worksheets, so the final checksum does not hash that mutable container.

These variants use a different answer-cell map from the student practice site. Grade them here with their original receipt. Numerical grading reuses the case’s Python grader in the browser. No file, name, answer or grade is uploaded to a grading server.
